samples.xml_description:
<module id="alu">
    <description>An arithmetic and logical unit (ALU) for a 32-bit MIPS-ISA CPU.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="a" width_description="[31:0]">A 32-bit input operand.</input>
        <input id="b" width_description="[31:0]">A 32-bit input operand.</input>
        <input id="aluc" width_description="[5:0]">Control signal for selecting the operation to be performed.</input>
        <output id="r" width_description="[31:0]">Result of the operation.</output>
        <output id="zero">Indicates whether the result is zero.</output>
        <output id="carry">Indicates whether a carry occurred during the operation.</output>
        <output id="negative">Indicates whether the result is negative.</output>
        <output id="overflow">Indicates whether an overflow occurred during the operation.</output>
        <output id="flag">General flag, set based on specific operations (SLT and SLTU).</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="ADD">6'b100000</parameter>
        <parameter id="ADDU">6'b100001</parameter>
        <parameter id="SUB">6'b100010</parameter>
        <parameter id="SUBU">6'b100011</parameter>
        <parameter id="AND">6'b100100</parameter>
        <parameter id="OR">6'b100101</parameter>
        <parameter id="XOR">6'b100110</parameter>
        <parameter id="NOR">6'b100111</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLT">6'b101010</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLTU">6'b101011</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLL">6'b000000</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRL">6'b000010</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRA">6'b000011</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLLV">6'b000100</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRLV">6'b000110</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRAV">6'b000111</parameter>
        <parameter id="LUI">6'b001111</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="res" width_description="[31:0]">Register to hold the result of the operation.</reg>
        <assign id="flag" value="'bz">Flag is initially set to high impedance.</assign>
        <always_comb>
            <case id="operation_selection">
                <when condition="aluc == ADD">
                    <assign id="res" value="a + b">Addition operation.</assign>
                </when>
                <when condition="aluc == ADDU">
                    <assign id="res" value="a + b">Unsigned addition operation.</assign>
                </when>
                <when condition="aluc == SUB">
                    <assign id="res" value="a - b">Subtraction operation.</assign>
                </when>
                <when condition="aluc == SUBU">
                    <assign id="res" value="a - b">Unsigned subtraction operation.</assign>
                </when>
                <when condition="aluc == AND">
                    <assign id="res" value="a & b">Bitwise AND operation.</assign>
                </when>
                <when condition="aluc == OR">
                    <assign id="res" value="a | b">Bitwise OR operation.</assign>
                </when>
                <when condition="aluc == XOR">
                    <assign id="res" value="a ^ b">Bitwise XOR operation.</assign>
                </when>
                <when condition="aluc == NOR">
                    <assign id="res" value="~(a | b)">Bitwise NOR operation.</assign>
                </when>
                <when condition="aluc == SLT">
                    <assign id="res" value="$signed(a) < $signed(b)">Set less than operation.</assign>
                    <assign id="flag" value="1'b1">Set flag to 1 for SLT.</assign>
                </when>
                <when condition="aluc == SLTU">
                    <assign id="res" value="a < b">Set less than unsigned operation.</assign>
                    <assign id="flag" value="1'b1">Set flag to 1 for SLTU.</assign>
                </when>
                <when condition="aluc == SLL">
                    <assign id="res" value="b << a[4:0]">Logical left shift operation.</assign>
                </when>
                <when condition="aluc == SRL">
                    <assign id="res" value="b >> a[4:0]">Logical right shift operation.</assign>
                </when>
                <when condition="aluc == SRA">
                    <assign id="res" value="$signed(b) >>> a[4:0]">Arithmetic right shift operation.</assign>
                </when>
                <when condition="aluc == SLLV">
                    <assign id="res" value="b << a[4:0]">Variable logical left shift operation.</assign>
                </when>
                <when condition="aluc == SRLV">
                    <assign id="res" value="b >> a[4:0]">Variable logical right shift operation.</assign>
                </when>
                <when condition="aluc == SRAV">
                    <assign id="res" value="$signed(b) >>> a[4:0]">Variable arithmetic right shift operation.</assign>
                </when>
                <when condition="aluc == LUI">
                    <assign id="res" value="{a[15:0], 16'h0}">Load upper immediate operation.</assign>
                </when>
                <default>
                    <assign id="res" value="32'hzzzz_zzzz">Default case.</assign>
                </default>
            </case>
        </always_comb>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        The ALU performs arithmetic and logical operations based on the control signal (aluc). It supports operations like addition, subtraction, bitwise AND, OR, XOR, NOR, comparison, shifting, and loading upper immediate values.
        
        The module uses parameters to define the control signals for various operations, such as ADD, SUB, AND, OR, etc. 
        
        The module assigns the input operands to the signed wires and the output result (r) to the lower 32 bits of the register (res[31:0]). The flag output is determined based on the control signal (aluc) and is set to '1' when the operation is SLT or SLTU, and 'z' (high-impedance) otherwise. The zero output is set to '1' when the result is all zeros, and '0' otherwise.
        
        Inside the always block, a case statement is used to perform the appropriate operation based on the control signal (aluc). The result is assigned to the register (res) accordingly. For shift operations (SLL, SRL, SRA, SLLV, SRLV, SRAV), the shift amount is determined by the value of 'a' or 'a[4:0]'. For the LUI operation, the upper 16 bits of 'a' are concatenated with 16 zeros to form the result.
        
        If the control signal (aluc) does not match any defined operation, the result is assigned as 'z' (high-impedance).
    </implementation>
    
</module>
